user.title: Connect Avarma heat pump
user.description: RS485-to-Ethernet gateway on COMM3 of the heat pump (9600 8N1). Transparent mode → 'RTU over TCP', Modbus TCP gateway mode → 'Modbus TCP'.

error.cannot_connect: No answer from the heat pump. Check protocol, IP/port, A/B wiring and 9600 8N1 on the gateway.

abort.already_configured: This heat pump is already configured.
